items.title: Intel Stock And 2 AI Infrastructure Leaders Tied To Chip Policy
items.summary: Right now AI policy is being written in real time, from a proposed U.S. “AI Force” to fresh talks between Washington and Beijing. That mix of support, softer regulatory signals and closer U.S.-China dialogue is pulling certain AI infrastructure and semiconductor stocks into the spotlight. This article focuses on three AI Infrastructure and Semiconductor Leaders from our screener that appear particularly sensitive to these headlines, and discusses what that could mean for your portfolio...

items.title: Eisman Says Buy Micron And SK Hynix. “In This Knife Fight You Want To Be The One Selling The Knives”
items.summary: Steve Eisman thinks the real winners of the AI arms race are not the chip designers everyone is fighting over but the suppliers equipping both sides of the battle. Five stocks have already lapped Nvidia in 2026, and Eisman ranks them by who survives if the whole AI ecosystem cracks.

items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Stock Trades At A Premium On Bigger Shareholder Returns
items.summary: Lam Research has delivered very strong gains over the past few years, which puts a lot of weight on one question for investors who care about valuation. Given that history, is the current share price properly grounded in the company’s earnings power today and what the market expects it to earn over time? Over the past 5 years, Lam Research has returned about 372%, which puts a spotlight on whether that kind of outcome is already fully reflected in the earnings profile investors are paying...
